mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis ( repositoryId, memberId, articleId, diffId, projectKey, projectName, coverage, bugs, complexity, codeSmells, duplicatedLinesDensity, vulnerabilities, analyzeDate, totalScore, checksum ) VALUES ( #{repositoryId}, #{memberId}, #{articleId}, #{diffId}, #{projectKey}, #{projectName}, #{coverage}, #{bugs}, #{complexity}, #{codeSmells}, #{duplicatedLinesDensity}, #{vulnerabilities}, NOW(), #{totalScore}, #{checksum} )
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(coverage) AS coverage, AVG(bugs) AS bugs, AVG(complexity) AS complexity, AVG(codeSmells) AS codeSmells, AVG(duplicatedLinesDensity) AS duplicatedLinesDensity, AVG(vulnerabilities) AS vulnerabilities, AVG(totalScore) AS totalScore FROM analysis WHERE repositoryId = #{repositoryId}

SELECT id, repositoryId, memberId, articleId, projectKey, projectName, coverage, bugs, complexity, codeSmells, duplicatedLinesDensity, vulnerabilities, analyzeDate, totalScore FROM analysis WHERE articleId = #{articleId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, repositoryId, memberId, diffId, projectKey, projectName, coverage, bugs, complexity, codeSmells, duplicatedLinesDensity, vulnerabilities, analyzeDate, totalScore FROM analysis WHERE diffId = #{diffId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM analysis WHERE checksum = #{checksum} LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(analyzeDate) AS analyzeDate, AVG(coverage) AS coverage, AVG(bugs) AS bugs, AVG(complexity) AS complexity, AVG(codeSmells) AS codeSmells, AVG(duplicatedLinesDensity) AS duplicatedLinesDensity, AVG(vulnerabilities) AS vulnerabilities, AVG(totalScore) AS totalScore FROM analysis WHERE repositoryId = #{repoId} GROUP BY DATE(analyzeDate) ORDER BY analyzeDate ASC
